subject: SECURITY HIGH: syncProgress unions client-supplied achievements into Firestore with no catalog check
description: PROVEN by Mallory 2026-08-09 against a local Firebase emulator (never production). functions/index.js:1049 syncProgress unions localData.achievements into users/{uid}.achievements with only a typeof-string check and a 1000-item cap (sanitizeStringArray). No membership check against any achievement catalog. deriveXP (index.js:981) then scans that merged array for /^(gate_d+|dark_arts_gated+)$/ and adds 500 XP per match, with NO check that the corresponding users/{uid}/gates/gateN document written by the real Cloud Function exists. REPRODUCTION: syncProgress with achievements ['game_coldhorizon','gate_99','totally_made_up_id_xyz'] returned success with xp 500, and an Admin SDK read confirmed all three strings persisted verbatim, including one matching no achievement definition anywhere in the codebase. gate_99 inflated real permanent XP with no gate completion. CRITICALLY firestore.rules lines 73-84 permits xp, level and achievements as client-updatable ON A STATED ASSUMPTION THAT IS FALSE: the rules comment says syncProgress derives them server-side and client values are ignored during sync. That is true for XP only. The achievements ARRAY CONTENTS are trusted verbatim on union. Blast radius: any signed-in student, own account only, no cross-user escalation, but permanent and cloud-backed. This is platform-wide, NOT Cold Horizon specific. Fix direction: validate every incoming achievement id against the definitions catalog and drop unknown ids, and derive gate XP from the gates subcollection rather than from strings in a client array.
